text: The next morning. <break time="0.8s" /> Waythorn left for his office. <break time="0.8s" /> Earlier than usual. <break time="0.8s" /> For he wished to be out of the house. <break time="0.8s" /> When Haskett came to see the child. <break time="0.8s" /> Crowded into the elevated train. <break time="0.8s" /> He found himself pressed against a tall man. <break time="0.8s" /> Whom he recognized with a start. <break time="0.8s" /> As Gus Varick. <break time="0.8s" /> His wifes second husband. <break time="0.8s" /> Varick politely mentioned. <break time="0.8s" /> That Sellers. <break time="0.8s" /> Waythorns senior partner. <break time="0.8s" /> Was laid up with gout. <break time="0.8s" /> And each man pretended. <break time="0.8s" /> That there was nothing awkward about their meeting. <break time="0.8s" /> At lunch in a crowded restaurant. <break time="0.8s" /> Waythorn noticed Varick at a table nearby. <break time="0.8s" /> Sipping a glass of brandy. <break time="0.8s" /> And then pouring the rest into his coffee. <break time="0.8s" /> It was a small habit. <break time="0.8s" /> Hardly worth noticing. <break time="0.8s" /> Yet Waythorn could not help watching him. <break time="0.8s" /> As if the man knew things about Alice. <break time="0.8s" /> That he himself did not know. <break time="0.8s" /> That evening. <break time="0.8s" /> As Alice poured the after dinner coffee. <break time="0.8s" /> She added a little cognac to his cup. <break time="0.8s" /> Without thinking. <break time="0.8s" /> And handed it to him with a smile. <break time="0.8s" /> I do not take cognac in my coffee. <break time="0.8s" /> Waythorn said lightly. <break time="0.8s" /> And Alice. <break time="0.8s" /> Suddenly realizing her mistake. <break time="0.8s" /> Exclaimed, Oh, how stupid of me. <break time="0.8s" /> And blushed a deep red. <break time="0.8s" /> The meaning of her blush. <break time="0.8s" /> Was painfully clear to Waythorn. <break time="0.8s" /> For the habit. <break time="0.8s" /> That she had remembered so naturally. <break time="0.8s" /> Belonged to her second husband.
